title: [UE-0.5] Test harness pattern
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Gameplay Dev

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Meta/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Shared/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Bootstrap/**`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Meta/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Shared/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Bootstrap/**`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.3

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.5a, UE-0.5b, UE-0.13, UE-0.23, UE-0.27

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `UmbrellaElla.Meta.SampleRule` (pure function, no world) passes headless through `tools/ue/test.sh`
- [ ] `UmbrellaElla.Meta.World.SampleWorld` passes: it creates a transient world in code (no .umap), spawns a plain stand-in actor (not Ella, so no later gameplay card changes its result), ticks 60 frames at 1/60 s and reads the world time 1.0 s and the actor's tick count 60 from the running world
- [ ] A temporary `UmbrellaElla.Meta.MustFail` is run once and `check_automation_report.py` prints FAIL (pasted); then it is removed
- [ ] `UmbrellaElla.Bootstrap.Placeholder` is removed; `tools/ue/test.sh` without `--bootstrap` prints PASS tests=2. Later cards copy this pattern

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
